free_parameters.name: shape
free_parameters.why: small fixed tensor shape; the target decision depends only on the tensor dtype, not on its shape or element count

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the random differentiable-test input inside PracticalHybridSearch.__init__ so repeated runs are identical

free_parameters.name: input_key
free_parameters.why: the single input key of the minimal schedule; it must be the readable name SymbolNet.forward expects

free_parameters.name: max_time_ms
free_parameters.why: bounds the post-target gradient loop only; the target decision at symbolnet.py:238 happens before the loop

free_parameters.name: dtype_mapping
free_parameters.why: maps the integer boundary variable onto the float/integer dtype categories the Region condition compares
